scene: The glowing drumstick unlocks three transit gates along the rooftop rim.
picture: Flat side-view across the rooftop edge. On the left, a glass escalator pod with doors open. Left of centre, the silver-haired boy in mint hoodie holds a glowing drumstick. Centre, a docked light-rail pod idles quietly. Far right, an entry gate leads onto a glowing moving walkway.
shown: a glass escalator pod waiting open on an illuminated track on the left
a sleek hovering light-rail pod docked at a small platform in the centre
a glowing moving walkway stretching outward from a barrier on the far right
